## Kind of change

- [ ] Typo, formatting or broken link
- [ ] Site code, styling or tests
- [ ] Informative document (D2, D3, D11, D12, D13) or a template
- [ ] Normative document (D1, D4 to D10), which changes what the methodology requires

## If a document changed

- [ ] `version`, `updated` and `citation` reflect the change
- [ ] The document's `documentId` is unchanged, and nothing was renumbered
- [ ] No informative document gained a requirement
- [ ] Nothing contradicts D1
- [ ] The publication date is still unique across the series

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] No em dashes or en dashes; British and New Zealand spelling
- [ ] I used an AI agent to prepare this change: yes / no
